create_data_provider: create a DataProvider instance to load and index image embeddings from a meta-dataset split
build_problem_instance: build a random N-way K-shot classification problem instance from indexed image embeddings
build_batch_instances: build a batch of shuffled N-way K-shot classification problem instances with configurable thread count
test_label_consistency: test that training and validation output labels sum to the expected correct label sum
summarize_data_index: summarize the data index by verifying image counts per class and checking for duplicates
